svg.data-input-dc: -48 to -60 VDC, 37 A max per supply
svg.data-power-max-w-ac: 808 (HIG AC section; the DC build's 811 is the figure carried as power-max-w)
svg.data-pdu-fuse-suggested: 30 A DC, 15 A AC (HIG provisioning guidance, not a draw)
svg.data-fans: 4x hot-swappable 3+1 redundant, exhaust airflow; system front-to-back
svg.data-altitude: rated for operation up to 5000 m (HIG Connecting Power, both input types)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO, ITU-T SyncE, IEEE 1588v2 (G.8265.1 default, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2 with additional licence; T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC), Time Sensitive Networking, ITU-T G.8273.2 T-BC Class C accuracy, IEEE 802.1CM
svg.data-timing-interfaces: GNSS SMA in, 1PPS SMB in/out, 10MHz SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in/out
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations - GPS/QZSS L1 C/A, GLONASS L1OF, BeiDou B1, SBAS L1 C/A (WAAS, EGNOS, MSAS, GAGAN), Galileo E1B/C; minimum RF sensitivity -166 dBm, and the port supplies up to 5 V DC / 150 mA to an active antenna
svg.data-gnss-exclusivity: the platform supports either GNSS or SMA-10MHz input at a time; the 10MHz input is disabled when the GNSS antenna is connected (HIG section 12)
svg.data-timing-cables: 50 ohm SMA coax with 1/4-36UNS-2B for GNSS; 50 ohm SMB coax with 10-32UNF-2A for 1PPS and 10MHz; shielded RJ45 for ToD, 3 m maximum
svg.data-routing: full Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6); programmable as a Broadband Network Gateway
svg.data-nos: NOS integration is necessary to activate the timing features
svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR, LR, ER; 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER; 1G SFP SX, LX, EX (datasheet compatible transceiver types)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR4, LR4, ER4, ZR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver types)
svg.data-optics-qsfp56: 200G QSFP56 SR4, FR4 (datasheet compatible transceiver types; the QSFP56 cages also take the QSFP28 optics at 40/100G)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10G SFP+ SR, LR, ER (datasheet compatible transceiver types; the two 10G management ports take the same optics as the SFP28 cages do at 10G)
svg.data-boot-time: approx 80 s from power-on under Ubuntu Linux; OOB Ethernet relinks in approx 40 s (HIG NEBS statements, both qualified as NOS-dependent)
svg.data-safety: IEC/EN 60825-1 laser Class 1 pluggables only (UL/CSA recognised modules); installation restricted to service personnel, indoors only
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; CAN ICES-003 (A)/NMB-003(A); CISPR 32 Class A; VCCI Class A
svg.data-nebs: NEBS statements only, not a stated certification level: suitable for installation as part of the Common Bonding Network (CBN); installable in Network Telecommunications Facilities where the National Electric Code applies; DC input terminals are DC-I (isolated DC return) and the RTN terminal is to be isolated from the chassis or rack; the intra-building OOB Ethernet port is for unexposed intra-building wiring only (GR-1089 Type 2, 4 or 4a) and must not be metallically connected to OSP wiring for more than 6 m. An external Surge Protection Device must be used with AC powered equipment, installed at the AC service entrance.
svg.data-installation: suitable for Information Technology Rooms per NEC Article 645 and NFPA 75

rect.data-members: port-96 port-97 port-98 port-99 port-100 port-101 port-102 port-103

g.data-description: led-mgmt-l: the management jack's left corner lamp, drawn lit green in HIG Figure 8 - which is also how the jack is known to be keyway-up, since a ganged RJ45 puts its lamps on the latch side. THE HIG TABLES NO MANAGEMENT-PORT LED for this platform, so the states here are the component default (led-a link, led-b activity, the green of Figure 8) and not a transcription; led-mgmt-r: the management jack's right corner lamp; same absence of a vendor table as its left-hand twin, and the same component default
g.title: mgmt

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - OFF (system timing synchronization disabled or in free-run mode), Solid Green (timing core synchronized to a PTP phase packet or an external timing source and frequency also locked), Blinking Green (synchronized with a PTP frequency-profile packet or an external SyncE source), Solid Amber (timing core acquiring or in holdover), Blinking Amber (synchronization fail, or acquiring/holdover timed out)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG SYS row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (host CPU/BMC boot complete), Solid Amber (power is up but host CPU/BMC boot failed). Three rows only: this table has no blinking state for SYS
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - OFF (fan modules are not initialized), Solid Green (all fan modules working normal), Blinking Amber (fan fail: one or more fans need service)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PS0 row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (PSU0 is working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU0 fail, PSU0 needs service). This platform gives each supply its own lamp rather than sharing one PWR lamp
g.title: led-ps0

g.data-description: HIG PS1 row - OFF (no power), Solid Green (PSU1 is working normal), Blinking Amber (PSU1 fail, PSU1 needs service)
g.title: led-ps1

g.data-description: HIG ID row - OFF (no power), Blinking Blue (beacon is enabled). Two rows, and the blue is the only colour this lamp is documented to show
g.title: led-id

g.data-description: the pair the datasheet calls '2 x 10G SFP+ management ports', printed 0 and 1 in their own sequence above their own two-row block
